title_en: Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of the Trade Union Law of the People's Republic of China in Civil Trial Work

articles.content_en: Article 1 When a People's Court hears a case involving a trade union organization, it shall recognize the status of the trade union organization established in accordance with the Trade Union Law as a social organization legal person. A trade union organization with legal person status shall independently enjoy civil rights and assume civil obligations in accordance with law. Enterprises, public institutions, and organs that have established trade unions, the trade unions so established, and enterprises invested in and run by trade unions shall, according to the provisions of laws and judicial interpretations, bear their respective civil liabilities.

Article 2 In accordance with Article 18 of the Trade Union Law, when a People's Court hears a labor dispute case involving the determination of the extended labor contract term for a full-time chairman, vice-chairman, or member of a primary trade union, the extended term shall be calculated from the date on which the term of the above-mentioned person's trade union post expires, and the extended period shall be equal to the term of his or her trade union post.
The "serious personal fault" as provided in Article 18 of the Trade Union Law refers to the circumstances provided in Item (2), Item (3), or Item (4) of Article 25 of the Labor Law of the People's Republic of China.

Article 3 Where a primary trade union or a higher-level trade union applies to a People's Court for an order of payment in accordance with Article 43 of the Trade Union Law, the Primary People's Court of the place where the respondent is located shall have jurisdiction.

Article 4 After a People's Court, in accordance with Article 43 of the Trade Union Law, accepts an application for an order of payment for the allocation and payment of trade union funds submitted by a trade union, it shall first solicit the opinions of the respondent. Where the respondent raises an objection only to the amount of the funds to be allocated and paid, the People's Court shall issue an order of payment for the part of the trade union funds not in dispute.
In hearing a case involving trade union funds, where it is necessary to determine the amount to be allocated and paid in accordance with the terms "all employees" and "total wages" as provided in Article 42, paragraph 1, item (2) of the Trade Union Law, the calculation of "all employees" and "total wages" shall be performed in accordance with the standards prescribed by the relevant state departments.

Article 5 In accordance with Article 43 of the Trade Union Law and the relevant provisions of the Civil Procedure Law, where a higher-level trade union applies to a People's Court for an order of payment or brings an action demanding that an enterprise or public institution allocate and pay trade union funds, the People's Court shall accept the case. Where a primary trade union requests to participate in the proceedings, the People's Court may permit it to participate as a co-applicant or co-plaintiff.

Article 6 In accordance with Article 52 of the Trade Union Law, when a People's Court hears a labor dispute case involving an employee or a trade union staff member whose labor contract has been terminated because of participation in trade union activities or performance of duties prescribed by the Trade Union Law, it may, upon the request of the party, adjudicate that the employing unit reinstate him or her and retroactively pay the remuneration that should have been received during the period from the termination of the labor contract; or, upon the request of the party, adjudicate that the employing unit pay compensation equal to twice his or her annual income and pay economic compensation for the termination of the labor contract in accordance with Articles 46 and 47 of the Labor Contract Law.

Article 7 Where an enterprise or public institution, without justifiable reasons, delays or refuses to allocate and pay trade union funds, the provisions of Article 188 of the Civil Code shall apply to the limitation of action period for a trade union organization to request the People's Court to protect its rights.

Article 8 Where a trade union organization applies to a People's Court for an order of payment regarding the allocation and payment of trade union funds, it shall pay an application fee in accordance with Article 14 of the Measures for the Payment of Litigation Costs; if, after the conclusion of the supervision procedure, the trade union organization separately brings an action, it shall pay litigation costs in accordance with the standards for acceptance fees for property cases prescribed in Article 13 of the Measures for the Payment of Litigation Costs.
